text:
nina: ping — new contributor reporting onboarding friction: sampleapp CI failing on mac runner with native gem compile.
alex: can you paste the CI snippet? usually missing mkmf / headers or wrong arch flags.
nina: ```
extconf.rb:10:in `require': cannot load such file -- mkmf (LoadError)
checking for clang... no
*** extconf.rb failed ***
```
kevin: yep, looks like the mac image lost dev headers in the last runner update. Quick workaround is to brew-install ruby or cache prebuilt native gems.
nina: pushed branch nina/ci/macos-gem-fallback with `brew install ruby@3.2` step and fallback `gem install ffi -- --enable-libffi-alloc`; CI green locally. PR coming.
devex-bot: PR 112 opened by nina in devex — reviewers requested: kevin, jen 
jen: thanks. separate but related: the sampleapp's auth helper uses short-lived tokens; during long-stream smoke tests we observed 401 mid-stream and the ruby client didn't recover cleanly. Other SDKs rebuild the request on auth refresh, rb-sdk reused keep-alive socket and the stream died.
kevin: that's a parity/maintenance issue — small PR acceptable: on 401->refresh for streaming endpoints, rebuild the HTTP request and force a new connection. Add unit + smoke.
nina: opened rb-sdk PR: https://git.example.com/redwood/rb-sdk/pulls/213 — minimal change to request lifecycle + test harness that simulates 401 then success for streaming.
ci-bot: build 9934 failed on macos-latest — https://ci.example.com/build/9934
jen: for the SDK fix add a guard so normal transient errors don't always trigger reconnect, only when refresh flow happened. Also add a short comment in code explaining why we force new conn for auth-refresh to avoid regressions.
kevin: will review. Also suggest adding a tiny integration smoke in sampleapp CI that runs a short streaming replay to catch regressions early.
nina: added smoke job and updated quickstart docs with a one-liner under "macOS prerequisites" about native build deps and Apple Silicon caveats. Filed follow-up doc issue: https://git.example.com/redwood/devex/issues/502
jen: nice. One more thing — add a note in the PR description about why we rebuild the request (parity + nebulous server behavior on half-closed keep-alive sockets) so future maintainers understand the risk.
nina: done. CI passed on the branch after pinning mac runner to an image with CLT and using cached arm64 gems. Merged both changes.
kevin: thanks — great example of a small maintenance fix + docs reducing onboarding friction.
jen: will add a short entry to the devex FAQ about token lifetimes + streaming reliability.
nina: thanks all :heart:
